description: Four stereo core frames whose header says an XCh extension follows, with no sync word where its size would put it, written in 14-bit words, little endian.

skip.decode: ffmpeg looks for the XCh sync word as the frame's header says and rejects the frame without it (dca_core.c: 'XCH sync word not found')
skip.libdca: libdca (dca_frames, 0.0.7) does not find a 14-bit frame that starts at an offset that is not a multiple of 4: its bitstream reader works on 32-bit words
